claim_ceiling: Synthetic manifest/source-admission contract only. No physical weld, WPS/PQR, NDT or structural qualification.

sources.title: NAFEMS MANWG Weld Validation Data Review
sources.known_scope_summary: Literature index covering experimental welding studies and availability of procedure, parameter, clamping, macrograph, temperature, residual-stress and distortion information.
sources.admission_notes: Discovery index only. Underlying member-download materials and individual papers require separate source-byte, access and rights admission.

sources.title: NeT Task Group 4 residual-stress measurement and analysis round robin on a three-pass slot-welded plate specimen
sources.known_scope_summary: Three-pass slot-welded AISI 316L(N) plate residual-stress measurement and numerical-analysis round robin, with instrument-to-instrument measurement variability.
sources.admission_notes: Candidate validation reference only. Obtain exact report/data files, measurement coordinates, uncertainty and reuse permission before numerical scoring.

sources.title: NeT Task Group 6 residual stress measurement and numerical analysis round robin on a three-pass slot nickel-base repair weld
sources.known_scope_summary: Three-pass Alloy 600 plate / Alloy 82 consumable repair weld with residual-stress measurements reported across five neutron-diffraction instruments.
sources.admission_notes: Candidate for measurement variability and method uncertainty. Exact artifacts and data rights remain to be established.

sources.title: Numerical Simulation and Experimental Investigation of Residual Stress in Multi-Pass Butt-Welded Joints of Q235 Thick Plates for Engine Structures
sources.known_scope_summary: 55 mm Q235 K-groove butt joint welded in 12 passes; the article reports blind-hole residual stress measurements and sequentially coupled thermal-mechanical FE.
sources.admission_notes: Article indicates CC BY 4.0. No raw instrument bytes are admitted. Extracted table/figure points need units, coordinates, uncertainty, attribution and independent transcription audit.

sources.title: Investigation of altering multi-pass welding sequences and mechanical constraints on stiffened panel distortion
sources.known_scope_summary: DH36 stiffened panel study with six weld lines and 18 passes; compares forward, back-step and center-out sequencing and free versus template-constrained conditions.
sources.admission_notes: Published abstract reports model-to-experiment thermal and mechanical comparisons. Full geometry, measurement definitions, source bytes and reuse rights must be reviewed.

sources.title: Horizontal welding deformation and residual stress of narrow slanted groove for thick plates
sources.known_scope_summary: Thick-plate narrow slanted-groove specimen with 13 CO2-shielded passes; reports temperature history, residual stress, deformation and hardness comparisons.
sources.admission_notes: Candidate cross-check. Verify exact raw/supplementary artifacts, source terms, measurement points and uncertainty before any numerical fixture is admitted.

sources.title: Intensive validation of computer prediction of welding residual stresses in a multi-pass butt weld
sources.known_scope_summary: Heavily instrumented 32 mm-wall, 910 mm-diameter multi-pass pipe weld with MIG root passes and submerged-arc completion; reports temperature/strain/displacement during welding and post-weld through-thickness residual stress.
sources.admission_notes: Candidate validation reference. The paper summary is not raw sensor data; obtain exact data, model inputs and rights before numerical scoring.

sources.title: A systematic numerical framework to predict welding residual stress distributions in curved steel plates for shipbuilding and offshore applications
sources.known_scope_summary: 2026 study of residual-stress distributions in curved welded plates for shipbuilding and offshore contexts, including empirical stress-field representations.
sources.admission_notes: Treat as literature metadata until actual experimental reference, measured profiles, geometry and model-input availability are confirmed.

sources.title: Numerical Simulation and Experimental Measurement of Residual Stresses in a Thick-Walled Buried-Arc Welded Pipe Structure
sources.known_scope_summary: Single-pass buried-arc/MAG circumferential weld on two S355J2+N pipes of Ø168 × 12 mm. Article records six outer-surface XRD residual-stress locations, model mesh/cooling/source assumptions and a comparison of measured and predicted axial/hoop residual-stress profiles.
sources.admission_notes: The article is CC BY 4.0, but its Data Availability Statement says Not applicable and measured residual-stress results are published as figures rather than raw measurement files. Treat only as rights-cleared literature metadata until measurement values, graph-digitization error and XRD uncertainty are independently reconstructed. This is a single-pass buried-arc case, not a matched multipass GMAW comparator.

sources.title: Experimental validation on multi-pass weld distortion behavior of structural offshore steel HSLA S460 using FE-based inherent strain and thermo-mechanical method
sources.known_scope_summary: Multi-pass GMAW distortion study on offshore structural steel S460G2+M. Compares thermo-mechanical FEM with an inherent-strain method. Publisher/institutional abstract records study-reported distortion error ranges of 8% for TMM and 12% for ISM, with low computation time.
sources.admission_notes: High-relevance shipbuilding/HSLA candidate. The accessible institutional record gives abstract metadata; full measurement data, error definition/denominator, specimen geometry, weld procedure, clamping/release conditions, uncertainty and raw source artifacts have not been admitted. Publisher record reports copyright under exclusive licence to the Materials Research Society. Keep rights and numerical scoring pending; do not compare 8%/12% directly with other studies without identical output definition and evaluation conditions.

cases.mutation: Retain a literature index as metadata only and prohibit numerical scoring
cases.rationale: A positive contract outcome is allowed to preserve useful discovery metadata without elevating it to a measured reference.

cases.mutation: Required source snapshot digest is absent
cases.rationale: A citation or DOI is not an immutable source artifact.

cases.mutation: Rights status is unknown or pending but numerical scoring is requested
cases.rationale: No dataset bytes or derived values may be admitted without an applicable rights basis.

cases.mutation: METADATA_ONLY source is used as a numerical validation target
cases.rationale: Literature metadata is discovery evidence, not measured reference data.

cases.mutation: Values transcribed from a figure are declared raw sensor data
cases.rationale: Raw, tabulated and digitized data classes must remain explicit.

cases.mutation: Specimen geometry or coordinate datum is missing
cases.rationale: Geometry and measurement coordinates are required to compare fields.

cases.mutation: Material grade/heat or applicable material property source is missing
cases.rationale: Material uncertainty cannot be silently replaced with a guessed nominal value.

cases.mutation: Necessary procedure/process inputs are absent but model output is scored
cases.rationale: Missing source-native inputs must be marked incomplete, not inferred without disclosure.

cases.mutation: Clamping, fixture or release history is absent
cases.rationale: Residual stress and distortion depend on the declared mechanical boundary history.

cases.mutation: Measurement uncertainty is absent or silently set to zero
cases.rationale: Instrument, calibration, placement and reconstruction uncertainty must be represented.

cases.mutation: Stress or temperature units differ between model and measurement
cases.rationale: A dimensional mismatch must not pass through implicit conversion or guessed units.

cases.mutation: Measurement positions lack a defined specimen frame or datum
cases.rationale: Spatial correspondence cannot be assumed from plot ordering.

cases.mutation: Thermocouple timestamps have an unresolved clock or trigger offset
cases.rationale: Transient response comparisons require explicit time alignment uncertainty.

cases.mutation: The same measurement values are used to calibrate and validate the model
cases.rationale: A fitted result is not an independent validation result.

cases.mutation: Points from one physical specimen occur in both training and test partitions
cases.rationale: Holdouts must group by physical specimen/weld, not random samples.

cases.mutation: The same specimen is represented under multiple aliases across partitions
cases.rationale: Stable physical identity is required to prevent disguised leakage.

cases.mutation: A model calibrated on one material class is asserted for a different unsupported class
cases.rationale: Transfer requires evidence for the new material/property domain.

cases.mutation: Clamped geometry is compared with post-restraint-release measurement
cases.rationale: Boundary-condition state must match the measured state.

cases.mutation: A report labels tabulated values as raw data without admitted byte artifacts
cases.rationale: Evidence class and exact source bytes must agree.

cases.mutation: Two conflicting source revisions are silently merged
cases.rationale: Conflict remains explicit until a source owner resolves it.

cases.mutation: Source content digest does not match the retrieved bytes
cases.rationale: Exact source identity must be verified.

cases.mutation: Mesh/time-step convergence is omitted from a numerical comparison
cases.rationale: Solution verification is distinct from physical validation.

cases.mutation: Heat-source or model energy imbalance is not reported
cases.rationale: A model result cannot omit fundamental conservation diagnostics.

cases.mutation: Surrogate prediction is emitted outside declared training support without abstention
cases.rationale: A prediction outside qualified support must not appear validated.

cases.mutation: Held-out predictive intervals materially under-cover observations
cases.rationale: Uncertainty performance must be reported with confidence and strata.

cases.mutation: Model result is promoted to WPS/PQR, weld acceptance, class approval or release authority
cases.rationale: A model benchmark does not grant engineering or statutory authority.

cases.mutation: A model's agreement with post-weld XRD residual-stress profiles is used to claim the predicted molten-pool peak temperature is physically validated, despite the source explicitly acknowledging omitted liquid-solid coupling and an unrealistic computed peak.
cases.rationale: Validation of one output (post-weld residual stress) cannot be promoted to a different output domain (local weld-pool thermophysics) when the source model explicitly documents an important limitation.

cases.mutation: Treat abstract-reported 8% thermo-mechanical and 12% inherent-strain distortion errors as directly comparable leaderboard scores against another model/case without an identical output metric, specimen, geometry, restraint, validation split, uncertainty and data-access basis.
cases.rationale: The abstract reports useful study-specific comparisons but the summary does not disclose enough information to establish a matched scoring denominator or admit the underlying measurements as a reusable numerical benchmark.
